target_customer: Frontier AI labs and enterprises that need RL training environments for coding and computer use
problem: Training agents on computer use and software engineering requires high fidelity, verifiable simulated environments that labs do not want to build themselves.
business_model: Custom RL environments sold to labs and enterprises (pricing not public)
product_category: RL environments for AI agent training

founders.name: Christopher Settles
founders.background_notes: From the YC page, which says the team includes ex-Amazon scraping engineers.

competitors.name: Mechanize
competitors.what: RL environments for AI coding agents, a small number of robust environments for labs
competitors.traction_then: Reported to have worked with Anthropic, unconfirmed

competitors.name: Prime Intellect
competitors.what: Open source Environments Hub for RL environments
competitors.traction_then: Hub aimed at researchers and startups

technical_complexity.rationale: Realistic computer-use and software environments with verifiable rewards need substantial engineering, but this is a services-heavy build rather than research-grade.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded rivals sell similar environments and customers are a few labs who can build in-house, so relationships and speed are the only visible edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Scale AI expanded into RL environments in September 2025 and well funded startups entered; no source shows Refresh acquired.

market_need_then: In 2025 AI labs were reported by TechCrunch to be investing heavily in RL environments to train agents, creating demand for third-party suppliers.

branding.domain_note: Uses refresh.dev, a .dev domain rather than the .com; acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found

branding.brand_signature: The training gyms metaphor in its tagline

brand_strength.rationale: A generic word shared by many unrelated companies; searches surface other Refresh companies and no press about this brand.

outcome_analysis: Refresh is an early RL environment vendor, active as of late 2026 with job listings reported by a directory and no news of shutdown or sale. Public funding and customer data are absent, and the segment has become crowded with larger funded entrants, so its trajectory is unknown.
notes: Company website refresh.dev could not be fetched because the fetch tool's safety check was rate-limited. Funding: only a single directory (Synaptic) says pre-seed in 2025 with no amount; unverified. Founder sources conflict: other directories name Erik Quintanilla as CTO and different CEOs; only the YC page fetch (Settles) is recorded as founder. Team size reads 8 or 9 depending on source.
